description: November 12 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 12 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: The November 12 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Closing the Neptune decan at nineteen degrees of Scorpio, November 12 carries a vivid imagination and the expressive number 3. Twelve reduces to 3 and points to performance, writing and charm. Combined with Scorpio's intensity, the reading suggests a compelling storyteller, someone who holds attention easily and whose humour has a pleasing hint of shadow.

Astronomically, November 12 puts the Sun near 19° Scorpio in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Neptune. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for November 12
paragraphs: A birthday on the 12th reduces as 1 + 2 = 3, so the birthday number is 3, but the compound holds two stories at once. The 1 brings self-direction and the 2 brings cooperation, and together they produce the 3's expressive, sociable energy. Twelfth-of-the-month natives are often described as communicators who can lead a conversation and also make space for others in it. As with every day number, this is a secondary influence beside the Life Path. Its particular gift tends to be creative work that depends on teamwork, where one voice sets the tone and many voices fill it out.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a November 12 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous November 12 birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 12 is the 316th day of the year (317th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Sagittarius, is usually complete within 11 days, by November 23.

By November 12 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a November 12 birthday are Sun Yat-sen (1866), Auguste Rodin (1840) and Hassan Rouhani (1948).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 12?
faq.answer: November 12 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 12?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 12 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 12th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 12?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 12, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 12?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on November 12 include Sun Yat-sen (1866), Auguste Rodin (1840) and Hassan Rouhani (1948). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
